fact: ANATS and Airtel Tchad signed a partnership on 8 May 2026 under which ANATS will verify Airtel's customer data and interconnect the two systems to identify mobile subscribers, with the enrolment campaign due to start in the following days (Tchadinfos report).

Tchadinfos reports that on 10 March 2026 the finance ministry and ANATS signed a memorandum for secure consultation of the national biometric population register, to improve identification, verification and authentication in administrative and financial procedures, with banks and mobile money operators present.
